posts.title: Hello, World!
posts.description: This is the first post on my new website. Currently, I’m 3/4 of the way through my mandatory Quarantine in Hong Kong. I’ve been telling myself to make a personal website for a while, so here it is! I built it with Jekyll and a LOT of inspriation from Brittany Chiang’s gorgeous website. Perhaps one day I’ll even get around to migrating it to Gatsby, which I think will make it easier for me to play
